scripts.dev: pnpm run clean && concurrently -c black,blue --kill-others-on-fail false "pnpm tsup --watch src --watch ../containers-shared/src --watch ../cli" "pnpm run check:type --watch --preserveWatchOutput"
scripts.test: dotenv -- pnpm run assert-git-version && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="$(node scripts/node-options-for-tests.js)" dotenv -- vitest
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm tsup && pnpm tsdown && pnpm run generate-json-schema
scripts.test:ci: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS="$(node scripts/node-options-for-tests.js)" pnpm run test run
